instruction: Set up VS Code so that '.git' folders are hidden in the file explorer.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to hide .git folders in the explorer view. Similar pattern to original task but targets .git folders instead of __pycache__. Evaluator checks if files.exclude has **/.git set to true in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct - successfully retrieves settings.json from the expected location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json) and returns the file path for metric consumption
Metric comparison logic is semantically correct - iterates through expected key-value pairs in nested dictionaries to verify each is PRESENT (not requiring exact equality)
Allows for additional user-defined exclusions in files.exclude - if a user has {"**/__pycache__": true, "**/.git": true}, the check correctly passes because **/.git: true is present
Expected value is semantically correct - {"files.exclude": {"**/.git": true}} is the correct VS Code configuration for excluding .git folders from the file explorer
Coverage is complete - the evaluator checks all requirements from the instruction (verifying that .git folders are excluded)
Runtime feasibility is good - getter can access persistent settings.json file, metric can parse JSON and perform comparison, no postconfig needed
Edge case handling is appropriate - returns 0.0 if settings.json is missing, cannot be read, or doesn't contain the required exclusion pattern
